questions.question_english: What is the primary purpose of the Leave Travel Concession (LTC) granted to Government servants?
options_english: To enable travel to the employee’s Home Town and across India for rest and recreation
To provide financial assistance for international tourism and official travel abroad
To compensate for the lack of medical facilities at the employee’s place of posting
To serve as an alternative monetary reward to the Annual Performance Appraisal
questions.explanation_english: The primary purpose of granting Leave Travel Concession to Central Government employees is to allow them to travel to their declared Home Town or to various destinations across India. This financial assistance scheme is designed to facilitate rest, recreation, and family visits, thereby promoting employee well-being and maintaining high productivity levels throughout their official service tenure.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सरकारी कर्मचारियों को अवकाश यात्रा भत्ते (LTC) का मुख्य उद्देश्य उन्हें उनके घोषित गृह नगर या भारत के विभिन्न स्थलों पर यात्रा करने की अनुमति देना है। यह वित्तीय सहायता योजना विश्राम, मनोरंजन और पारिवारिक यात्राओं को सक्षम बनाने के लिए बनाई गई है, जिससे कर्मचारियों की भलाई को बढ़ावा मिलता है और उनके आधिकारिक सेवा काल के दौरान उच्च उत्पादकता स्तर बनाए रखा जा सके।

questions.question_english: A Government servant (Pay Level 12) takes an advance of ₹40,000 for an LTC journey for their family. The actual eligible claim upon submission of tickets and completion of journey comes out to be ₹35,000. What must the employee do?
options_english: Refund the unutilized ₹5,000 immediately to avoid penal interest
Retain the balance ₹5,000 and adjust it against next year’s LTC claim
Use the ₹5,000 for local sightseeing and submit generic fuel receipts
Forfeit the entire claim amount and refund ₹40,000 to the government
questions.explanation_english: When the actual eligible claim for a Leave Travel Concession journey is less than the advance drawn, the employee must refund the unutilized balance amount immediately. Prompt repayment of the remaining advance prevents the levy of penal interest, which is automatically charged on delayed unutilized advance amounts under government audit regulations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जब Leave Travel Concession यात्रा के लिए वास्तविक पात्रता दावा अग्रिम राशि से कम होता है, तो कर्मचारी को तुरंत अवशिष्ट राशि वापस करनी चाहिए। शेष अग्रिम की त्वरित पुनर्भुगतान दंडात्मक ब्याज के आरोप से बचाता है, जो सरकारी ऑडिट नियमों के तहत विलंबित अवशिष्ट अग्रिम राशि पर स्वचालित रूप से लगाया जाता है।

questions.question_english: How does the receipt of a family pension affect the dependency status of a widowed mother for LTC purposes?
options_english: If pension plus DR exceeds ₹9,000 per month, she is not dependent
Family pension is completely exempted from all income calculation criteria for dependency
She remains dependent as long as the family pension is her only primary source of income

questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'If pension plus DR exceeds ₹9,000 per month, she is not dependent'. The receipt of a family pension by a widowed mother directly impacts her dependency status for Leave Travel Concession purposes. If the total monthly amount received as family pension plus Dearness Relief exceeds nine thousand rupees, she fails the dependency test. Exceeding this financial ceiling makes her ineligible for inclusion in travel claims.
